hw_name.description: Smart LED control, tilt remote and stock OW BMS bridge for the VESC Express.

led_enabled.description: Enable the LED module (needs the ESPLED Strip native lib).

bms_enabled.description: Enable the stock OW BMS RS485 bridge.

humidity_enabled.description: Enable the Si7021/AHT20 humidity sensor loop.

gnss_enabled.description: Enable the GNSS receiver (u-blox or NMEA). Feeds the gnss-* extensions, the SD log position (Log GNSS) and the CAN GNSS broadcast.

can_id.description: CAN ID of the VESC. -1 scans and picks the first one found.

can_loop_delay.description: Telemetry poll rate on the CAN bus.

led_on.description: Master LED on/off. Also toggled from the QML page and mall grab.

led_mode_status.description: Style of the footpad indication on the status bar.

led_mode_button.description: Pattern of the single button LED.

led_mall_grab_enabled.description: Show the status pattern when the board is held nose-up.

led_brake_light_enabled.description: Strobe the rear strip red when braking.

led_brake_light_min_amps.description: Motor current threshold below which the brake light triggers.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without activity before the idle pattern shows.

idle_timeout_shutoff.description: Seconds without activity before the LEDs turn off.

led_max_brightness.description: Upper limit applied to every LED brightness.

led_dim_on_highbeam_ratio.description: How much the rest of the strip dims while the highbeam is on.

led_startup_timeout.description: How long the startup pattern shows after boot.

led_loop_delay.description: Update rate of the LED state logic.

led_show_battery_charging.description: Show the battery pattern while the charger is plugged in.

led_front_timing.description: Front strip: disabled, or the wire timing preset to drive it with.

led_front_pin.description: GPIO of the front strip data line.

led_front_num.description: Number of LEDs on the front strip (highbeam LEDs not included).

led_front_type.description: Color order / RGBW type of the front strip.

led_front_reversed.description: Reverse the pixel order of the front strip.

led_front_highbeam_mode.description: Front highbeam hardware: a separate PWM-driven pin, or LEDs embedded in the strip itself.

led_front_highbeam_pin.description: PWM highbeam GPIO for the front (highbeam mode PWM Pin).

led_front_highbeam_pos.description: Embedded highbeam LED positions within the strip, packed one per byte from the lowest, 255 = unused (e.g. positions 3,8,14,19 = 320014339).

led_front_highbeam_min.description: Embedded highbeam brightness is mapped onto the min-max drive range some light bars expect.

led_front_highbeam_max.description: Embedded highbeam brightness is mapped onto the min-max drive range some light bars expect.

led_rear_timing.description: Rear strip: disabled, or the wire timing preset to drive it with.

led_rear_pin.description: GPIO of the rear strip data line.

led_rear_num.description: Number of LEDs on the rear strip (highbeam LEDs not included).

led_rear_type.description: Color order / RGBW type of the rear strip.

led_rear_reversed.description: Reverse the pixel order of the rear strip.

led_rear_highbeam_mode.description: Rear highbeam hardware: a separate PWM-driven pin, or LEDs embedded in the strip itself.

led_rear_highbeam_pin.description: PWM highbeam GPIO for the rear (highbeam mode PWM Pin).

led_rear_highbeam_pos.description: Embedded highbeam LED positions within the strip, packed one per byte from the lowest, 255 = unused (e.g. positions 3,8,14,19 = 320014339).

led_rear_highbeam_min.description: Embedded highbeam brightness is mapped onto the min-max drive range some light bars expect.

led_rear_highbeam_max.description: Embedded highbeam brightness is mapped onto the min-max drive range some light bars expect.

led_status_timing.description: Status bar: disabled, or the wire timing preset to drive it with.

led_status_pin.description: GPIO of the status bar data line.

led_status_num.description: Number of LEDs on the status bar.

led_status_type.description: Color order / RGBW type of the status bar.

led_status_reversed.description: Reverse the pixel order of the status bar.

led_footpad_timing.description: Footpad strip: disabled, or the wire timing preset to drive it with.

led_footpad_pin.description: GPIO of the footpad strip data line.

led_footpad_num.description: Number of LEDs on the footpad strip.

led_footpad_type.description: Color order / RGBW type of the footpad strip.

led_footpad_reversed.description: Reverse the pixel order of the footpad strip.

led_button_timing.description: Single button LED: disabled, or the wire timing preset to drive it with.

led_button_pin.description: GPIO of the button LED data line.

pubmote_remote_mac_a.description: Paired remote MAC (upper bytes). Set by the pairing flow.

pubmote_remote_mac_b.description: Paired remote MAC (lower bytes). Set by the pairing flow.

pubmote_secret_code.description: Pairing secret. Set by the pairing flow.

bms_rs485_di_pin.description: GPIO wired to the transceiver DI.

bms_rs485_ro_pin.description: GPIO wired to the transceiver RO.

bms_rs485_dere_pin.description: GPIO wired to the transceiver DE/RE.

bms_wakeup_pin.description: GPIO that wakes the BMS, -1 if unused.

bms_override_soc.description: Report the locally estimated SOC instead of the BMS one.

bms_charge_only.description: Only talk to the BMS while charging.

cell_type.description: Battery cell type for the voltage curve.

bms_key_a.description: Stored BMS pairing key. Set from the QML page.

bms_key_b.description: Stored BMS pairing key. Set from the QML page.

bms_key_c.description: Stored BMS pairing key. Set from the QML page.

bms_key_d.description: Stored BMS pairing key. Set from the QML page.

bms_counter_a.description: Stored BMS counter. Set from the QML page.

bms_counter_b.description: Stored BMS counter. Set from the QML page.

bms_counter_c.description: Stored BMS counter. Set from the QML page.

bms_counter_d.description: Stored BMS counter. Set from the QML page.

log_append_gnss.description: Append GNSS position to log samples (needs GNSS enabled).

humidity_sda_pin.description: I2C SDA GPIO of the humidity sensor.

humidity_slc_pin.description: I2C SCL GPIO of the humidity sensor.

gnss_type.description: u-blox modules are driven by the firmware driver; any other NMEA module is read from a plain UART.

gnss_rx_pin.description: GPIO wired to the module's TX output.

gnss_tx_pin.description: GPIO wired to the module's RX input. Required for u-blox, optional for NMEA (read-only).

gnss_baud.description: UART baud rate (NMEA type only - the u-blox driver manages its own).

mqtt_enabled.description: Publish telemetry and accept commands over MQTT. Needs Wi-Fi configured and connected (VESC Express Wi-Fi settings).

mqtt_broker_uri.description: Broker URI, e.g. mqtt://host:1883 or mqtts://host:8883.

mqtt_client_id.description: MQTT client id. Blank auto-generates one.

mqtt_user.description: Broker username. Blank for no authentication.

mqtt_topic_prefix.description: Base topic: telemetry is published to <prefix>/telemetry and commands are read from <prefix>/cmd.

mqtt_qos.description: Quality of service for publishes and the command subscription.

accept_tos.description: Set once the terms-of-service prompt was accepted.
